title: JPMorgan, Visa, Mastercard Cite Third-Party Incidents Amid Data Leak
description: JPMorgan Chase, Visa, and Mastercard have disclosed data leak incidents involving third-party service providers targeted by the N0n extortion group. The leaked data reportedly includes customer marketing information such as names, email addresses, phone numbers, and some employee emails, but no payment card data or payment systems were affected. The companies emphasize that their core payment networks and services remain secure, and they are investigating the incidents while offering credit monitoring where appropriate.
